items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Hale did some charts for me... And on Gongs East we have couple arrangements by Hale Smith.

ctx.x: But that brings up a very important chapter, at least as far as musical history. Where did you meet Hale Smith and how? Was it in Cleveland?

No. I met Hale here in New York come to think about it, and he and Jim Hall knew each other because they were both from Cleveland and he came to a rehearsal we had and we hooked up and, you know, stayed friends ever since. And Hale did some charts for me, you know, but Jim Hall was the reason I met Hale. I think we were at Birdland at the time, you know. And he was here in New York.
Was that how he and Eric got hooked up or do you know how that relationship came?
